title: Hardship Settlement Decision Table for Previously Placed, Inactive Accounts
content:
# Hardship Settlement — Dormancy Reductions

**Rule.** For a Hardship Settlement offer under Ridgeline's Settlement Agreements, where two or more collection agencies worked the account before this placement and no consumer payment was posted to it with a date after the same calendar day twelve months before the offer date, the Hardship Settlement dormancy reduction of 2.0 points applies; where exactly one agency worked it before this placement and no consumer payment was posted in that same twelve-month span, the Hardship Settlement single-agency dormancy reduction of 1.0 point applies; in every other case the account carries no dormancy reduction for a Hardship Settlement.

Both facts are on the Placed Consumer Accounts record: the number of prior agency placements and the consumer payments posted in the money history.

| Prior agencies | No consumer payment posted in the span | Reduction |
|---|---|---|
| two or more | true | 2.0 percentage points |
| two or more | false | none |
| exactly one | true | 1.0 percentage point |
| exactly one | false | none |
| none | true or false | none |

## Hypothetical span

With a hypothetical offer dated the 3rd of a month, the span covers payments dated after the 3rd of that month one year earlier; a payment dated exactly that earlier 3rd does not fall inside it.
